description: Replace a five-line if-block with one line. DISTILL-CANARY-537f0222

files.scripts/打包发布.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)

if [ -d dist ]; then
  echo "cleaning dist"
  rm -rf dist
  mkdir dist
fi

tar czf "dist/app-$VERSION.tgz" src
echo "packed $VERSION"
